user.title: EZVIZ Live
user.description: Uses the session of the account already set up in the EZVIZ integration. No password is asked for or stored.

abort.ezviz_missing: Set up the EZVIZ integration with your cloud account first.

data_description.allow_webrtc: Many EZVIZ cameras send H.265. Off: the camera uses HLS only. On: go2rtc tries WebRTC, which only shows H.265 in browsers that support it.

verification_code.title: {name}: verification code missing
verification_code.description: Image encryption is on for {name} ({serial}), so the video arrives encrypted. Add the camera to the EZVIZ integration with the verification code from the device label, or turn image encryption off in the EZVIZ app.

ezviz_missing.message: The linked EZVIZ account was removed.
